snippet.title: Battlefield 6 Season 1 Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
All-Out Warfare hits Southern California on October 28 in Battlefield 6. 

Season 1 rolls out in three phases with new hardware, gadgets, maps, and monthly drops for Portal. Blackwell Fields spans besieged facilities and homesteads under a burning horizon, supporting all combat sizes with land and air. Eastwood turns a quiet villa and golf retreat into a frontline, with land vehicles and helicopters in play. 

Rogue Ops leads with Strikepoint, while the rest of Season 1 builds the fight even further in the months ahead.
